user.title: Monitor your home
user.description: Select sources and define functions or entity-bound situations. Notifications are off initially and are emitted as events for your consumer automation. Situation rules must report source loss as unavailable, never off. Timing values are seconds except the coalescing count. See the README for YAML examples.
